a. Show that the wavelength of the detected light is 540 nm.

b. The light from the star is incident on a double slit. The following intensity pattern is observed on a screen at a distance of cm from the slits:

i. Explain why intensity is zero at P.

ii. The distance between the slits is mm. Find the distance between P and the central maximum.

i. State three changes to the pattern that is observed on the screen after this modification.
